assessment: Perkaholic 1.07 (2019): its pak stores the table files as ../../../Data/Libs/Tables/rpg/*.tbl, paths that climb out of the pak, with an obsolete .tbl extension. This reads as a packaging mistake of an old mod, not as malware, but path climbing is exactly what the check exists for. Superseded by 85 and 1009 (both downloaded). Quarantined; not needed.

Realistic Horses carries its small data part (4 tables: buff, rpg_param, equippable_item, soul; lower horse and player carrying capacity) plus the complete community cheat-console framework (v1.58, 24 cheat_*.lua, Startup/main.lua, loadstring/loadfile/io.open) and autocheat.lua, which runs cheat_remove_perk and cheat_add_perk at every start. No network or command execution found, but unexpected code that changes player perks. If the data part is wanted, re-pack the *__RH.xml tables without Scripts/.

KCSE plugin (native DLL, built by GitHub Actions per its pdb path): registers the rpg params as console variables; refuses to load on an unknown game build. No suspicious API or URL strings. Native code cannot be verified by reading, so it is held; restore after a Windows Security scan if wanted. Needs KCSE and Address Library.

Permadeath: LightFX64.dll (name of a vendor library, used here as a hook carrier) hooks WHGame.dll (game-over and playline hooks, refuses to patch an unknown build), plus Install-Permadeath.cmd and Uninstall-Permadeath.cmd. Native code and scripts: held.
ASI plugin (MinHook): hooks the repair check and enables a global zero-health repair override. Native code: held. Needs an ASI loader or KCSE.

KcdCombatTune.asi and KCDT.asi: native plugin that exports KCDT_* functions (actor brain, soul skill and stat, defense weights, defense override) and hooks inventory, item transfer and input registration; it is the engine behind the Master Strike and defense tuning. Native code: held.
Ships a .7zip next to the data: the game cannot read .7zip, so which file is the real pak decides whether the mod works at all. Not a security finding.

The extracted folder is an older version of the mod with Data/Tables/rpg/*__perkaholic.xml (no Libs/ root, so not loaded) and a perkaholic.7zip; the .rar is the current version (a ZIP pak with Libs/Tables). Use the .rar.
Two .7zip files (Riposte.7zip, Data/Riposte.7zip): not readable by the game; the working pak is elsewhere in the folder or must be re-packed. Not a security finding.

Ships an installer for engine config (DIY Engine, sys_spec_Physics.cfg: physics cvars) and one Lua script (PickableItem__zzzxdddbrdp.lua) that uses loadstring. Engine-level physics changes, not malware-shaped; worth reading the script before use.
